verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud is a hosted service, so choosing a data-storage region is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents a region or residency selection for stored data. Residential proxies across 195+ countries control browsing egress location, not where data is stored. SOC 2/HIPAA claims and the local open-source library are compliance and deployment alternatives, not a residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
